ACT X OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN SEA FISHERIES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
An Act further to amend the
Balochistan Sea Fisheries Ordinance, 1971
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 23rd October, 1994]
No.PAB/LEGIS/V(14)/94, dated
23-10-1994.--The Balochistan Sea Fisheries (Amendment) Bill, 1994 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly on 9th October, 1994 and assented to by the
Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Assembly.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Balochistan Sea Fisheries (Amendment) Act, 1994.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 1st day of July, 1991.

Amendment of section 9 of Ordinance IX of 1971

2. Amendment of section 9 of Ordinance IX of 1971.-In the said
Ordinance, in section 9, for the words "five thousand rupees" the
words "rupees one lac" shall be substituted.

Insertion of new sections 9-A and 9-B in Ordinance IX of 1971

ACT X OF 1994
ACT X OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN SEA FISHERIES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
An Act further to amend the
Balochistan Sea Fisheries Ordinance, 1971
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 23rd October, 1994]
No.PAB/LEGIS/V(14)/94, dated
23-10-1994.--The Balochistan Sea Fisheries (Amendment) Bill, 1994 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly on 9th October, 1994 and assented to by the
Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Assembly.
3. Insertion of new sections 9-A and 9-B in Ordinance IX of 1971.--In
the said Ordinance, after section 9, the following new sections shall be
inserted, namely:
"9-A.
Custody of Poachers and Poaching Vessel.--The Fisheries Officer will hand over
the poachers and their poaching vessel in the safe custody of
Tehsildar/Assistant Commissioner of the respective areas as soon' as they are
brought ashore and until such time they are prosecuted.
9-B. Auction of
illegal fish.--The illegal fish catch, is a perishable commodity and the
fisheries Officers straightaway proceeds to dispose of the same through open
auction and keep the auction amount in safe custody till the poacher is
prosecuted and the prescribed period for appeal expires. Whereupon the auction
money is deposited under the Head of Fisheries Receipt. In case of acquittal,
the amount is returned to the poacher."
